mapper.select: /* RiskAi01Mapper.selectAssessmentForAi */ SELECT A.INIT_DESC , A.ASSESSMENT_DESC , A.INIT_FILE_MGMT_CD , C.BAIM_VAL_D_NM AS PROCESS_NM , D.RISK_TYPE_NM AS RISK_TYPE_NM , CASE WHEN A.HAZARD_CD = 'self' THEN A.ASSESSMENT_DESC ELSE E.HAZARD_NM END AS HAZARD_NM FROM TB_RISK_ASSESSMENT A INNER JOIN ( SELECT A.BAIM_VAL_D_CD , A.BAIM_VAL_D_NM FROM TB_BAIM_VAL_D A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND A.BAIM_VAL_CD = 'COM002' AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' ) C ON ( A.PROCESS_CD = C.BAIM_VAL_D_CD ) INNER JOIN TB_RISK_TYPE D ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = D.CMPNY_CD AND A.RISK_TYPE_CD = D.RISK_TYPE_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_RISK_SITE_HAZARD E ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = E.CMPNY_CD AND A.RISK_TYPE_CD = E.RISK_TYPE_CD AND A.HAZARD_CD = E.HAZARD_CD ) WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND A.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND A.PROCESS_CD = #{processCd} AND A.ASSESSMENT_CD = #{assessmentCd}
